layout_columns.intro_position: above the content grid, on its own band
layout_columns.order: original publication date descending, left to right, then the next row
layout_columns.opening_view: On a desktop stage at least 1100px wide, the first load of a layout revision scales the camera so all eight cards of the newest row are inside the window. Narrow screens frame about two readable cards instead of shrinking the whole row to unreadability. Pan and zoom remain.
layout_columns.applies_to: default first load of a layout revision, and the 按日期排开 action
layout_columns.future_updates: Keep eight content cards per row, and keep the desktop opening view showing that whole row. The earlier ten-per-row rule is superseded. Do not go back to scale 1 that leaves most of the row offscreen. Version the stylesheet and script URLs with the layout revision.

date_sort_policy: On the first load of a new content revision, every content card is laid out by original publication date, newest first, eight per row, on fresh and returning browsers. A desktop window shows that whole newest row. The intro tile stays above that grid and does not take a slot. Saved x/y and camera from an older revision are not applied. Within the same revision, freeform drag still persists locally. Day-only dates sort after known clocks on that day. Adding a link never changes a card's original date. Stored notes are kept and are not shown as inputs. Projects whose official page gives no publication date sort after every known date, in a stable tie order, and are not dated with the model launch day or the day they were collected.
